full_judgment: 48. PW 35 Md. Ahsan Azim, Sub Divisional Engineer, Moulovibazar ascertained the value of furniture in the houses of the accused at Taka 4,45,400. He proved the statement Exhibit- 28, his signatures-28/2-5. In the cross-examination he replied that he did not serve any notice to the owner of the houses. He denied that he prepared the statement on presumption. He did not know whether the furniture was given by the mother-in-law of accused.
